# EraseStroke&lt;TPixel&gt;

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Editing` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public sealed class EraseStroke<TPixel> : RegionEditCommand<TPixel>
```

Erases to transparency — sets alpha to 0, keeping every other channel — along a path.

**Type parameters**

- `TPixel` - The pixel the target surface stores.

- `opacity` (`OpacityLock`) - Carried for symmetry with the other commands; erase writes alpha 0, which both modes admit unchanged.
